title: Read-only Claude reviewer policy refuses standalone `git rev-list --parents -n 1 HEAD`
outcome: A read-only Claude reviewer can run the bounded form `git rev-list --parents -n 1 <rev>` (or a documented equivalent) to verify a commit's parents, with the same output and exec-sink protection as the other listing subcommands. The current allowlist in src/claude.rs (around line 1775) admits diff, log, show, blame, describe, ls-files, rev-parse, shortlog, status and patch-id, but not rev-list. So the policy refused it ('refused by TermAl read-only policy') for Engram 12329's R2 Claude reviewer (session-16809, delegation 091f8ba4) at both boundaries, while Codex ran it. The reviewer used the supported substitute `git show -s --format="%H %P" HEAD`, so coverage was not lost. Either admit a narrow rev-list form or document the supported substitute in the reviewer guidance, so reviewers stop running into the refusal. Source: Engram::Coder-VerificationWorkspaceSol mailbox #294, 2026-11-08.
acceptance: Read-only Claude reviewer policy refuses standalone `git rev-list --parents -n 1 HEAD` is done
